title: Rust TUI — unified 4+2 screen layout
description: Refactor existing lichen-tui to match the unified screen vocabulary. Tab/number keys 1-4 for primary screens (Messages, Map, Peers, Status), 5-6 for secondary (Settings, Keys). Vim-style navigation (j/k, Enter, q). Status bar top line. Color: green/yellow/red for signal/battery. 80x24 minimum. CoAP Observe for data binding. Spec: 11-lci.md §17.8.7 TUI specifics, §17.8.8. Rust in lichen-tui/.
